title: Unit 2 · Steigerung der Adjektive
rule:
Kurze Adjektive: **-er / -est**: tall → taller → the tallest
Endet auf -e: nice → nicer → the nicest
Konsonant + y → **-ier / -iest**: happy → happier → the happiest
Kurzer Vokal + Konsonant → **verdoppeln**: big → bigger → the biggest
Lange Adjektive: **more / most**: expensive → more expensive → the most expensive
Unregelmäßig: good → **better → the best**; bad → **worse → the worst**
Vergleich: taller **than** … · as tall **as** …

words.s: This is {the biggest} cake in the shop!
This book is {more interesting} than the film.
The Shard is {the tallest} building in London.
My test was {better} than last time.
That was {the best} day of my life!
The weather today is {worse} than yesterday.
This dress is {more expensive} than that one.
Maths is {the most difficult} subject for me.
This is {the funniest} film I know.
My dog is as big {as} your dog.
Is a cab {cheaper} than the Tube?
